name: Jupiter

albedo.title: PIA07782 cylindrical cloud mosaic
albedo.rights: NASA mission imagery; original credit retained
albedo.processing: 3601x1801 TIFF to three LODs; no generated storms, bump, or noise; 750nm+451nm near-natural-color scientific reconstruction
albedo.primeMeridianOrOrientationNotes: North up, west-positive graticule 180 at left, 0 at center, 180 right => east-positive -180..180; System III features fixed at source epoch

visualEnhancements: VISUAL_ENHANCEMENT: approximate Minnaert cloud-top photometry k=0.85; switchable to Lambert, not a fitted radiance model
limitations: GRS and vortices represent December 2000, not the selected date
Near-natural color synthesized from blue and near-IR, not calibrated full visible spectrum
Smallest source features about 120km; 4096 derivative does not add detail
No fictional cloud height or differential atmospheric wind animation
description: Cassini 2000 年云顶快照，云带与大红斑均有观测来源；不代表当前风暴位置。
